name: godmode
description: Engineering discipline for AI coding agents: question the request, verify against current docs instead of memory, plan, build test-first, review with a second model family, prove it before saying done.

interface.shortDescription: Question, verify, plan, test first, review, prove: discipline for coding agents
interface.longDescription: GodMode makes a coding agent work like a senior engineer: it questions whether the work is worth doing, designs before coding, verifies every fact that can change against current documentation, plans atomic tasks, builds test-first on the cheapest capable model, reviews each task twice and with a second model family, and proves the result with fresh output before claiming completion.
defaultPrompt: I want to add a feature to this project.
Something is broken and I don't know why.
